# Openmarket

> Openmarket is a free iOS app — a better way to browse local Marketplace listings. Buyers get filters that work (a real place-and-radius search) and actually local listings: the city, distance, and walking/driving/transit travel time on every listing, plus saves and recently-viewed history, a unique "Only new listings" filter that hides everything already opened, and feeds with sponsored posts filtered out. Sellers get price comparisons: the Price Check tool recommends an asking price backed by similar listings and recent sales nearby — from a photo or a one-sentence description — plus a ready-to-paste title and description.

Openmarket is an independent app, not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc. Users browse with their own account; messaging and offers happen in the Facebook app via deep links.

Availability: iOS. Website: https://openmarket.so

## Pages

- [Home](https://openmarket.so/): what Openmarket is, buyer and seller features, FAQ
- [For buyers](https://openmarket.so/buyers): search, filters, distance and travel time, saves, only-new-listings
- [For sellers](https://openmarket.so/sellers): Price Check — local comps, sold data, ready-to-paste listings
- [Guides](https://openmarket.so/guides): practical guides to buying and selling secondhand locally

## Guides

- [Facebook Marketplace vs OfferUp vs Openmarket](https://openmarket.so/guides/facebook-marketplace-vs-offerup-vs-openmarket): honest three-way comparison — inventory, fees, filtering, shipping, safety
- [Facebook Marketplace location filter not working?](https://openmarket.so/guides/facebook-marketplace-location-filter-not-working): why radius settings don't limit results and how to actually search nearby
- [Stop scrolling past the same listings](https://openmarket.so/guides/stop-seeing-same-listings-facebook-marketplace): workarounds for repeated feeds, and filtering on your own view history
- [How to price used items](https://openmarket.so/guides/how-to-price-used-items): sold-data-first pricing method with percentage-of-retail baselines
- [Local pickup safety](https://openmarket.so/guides/local-pickup-safety-tips): meeting spots, payment rules, and scam patterns for local deals
